title: RitualCore Altar: Core Loop
summary: Prepare, diagnose, offer, ignite, and stabilize each ritual attempt.

blocks.title: Prepare
blocks.body: Build the array, place pedestal inputs, and confirm the held item or catalyst matches the ritual target.

blocks.title: Diagnose
blocks.body: Check structure and requirements before ignition. Diagnostics are cheaper than losing rare ingredients.

blocks.title: Resolve
blocks.body: Run the ritual, read completion or failure feedback, then reset inputs and stability before the next attempt.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
